note: Art direction for the cast, kept in content rather than in code because which character stands in for which biblical section is a product decision. Named, designed art for the Lamplighter, all six guide personas (content/personas.json), and every story character/NPC landed 2026-07-29 and is wired here. Six of the six persona folders under art/Characters/ are named after the folder's own archetype, not the final persona name (see the OT Poetry/Wisdom row below) -- do not assume folder name == persona name. Dialogue-portrait busts (24x24 head-and-shoulders art) exist only for the generic ex_* stand-ins; none exist yet for the Lamplighter or any of the six personas, so every guide's `portrait` field below still points at its old ex_* stand-in on purpose, unchanged from before this file's rewrite. Story characters and NPCs carry no portrait at all: DialogueBox never renders one. Sheet and portrait geometry, and the row-to-direction order, are recorded in src/game/spriteDirections.ts. Skin-tone picks (tone1/2/3) are an art-direction call with no authority in this repo; see PRD-12's DECISIONS for the full list, freely overridable per row without touching code.
